name: 53098 · Watertown, WI
findings: ZIP 53098 (Watertown) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53098 (Watertown) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 53098 (Watertown) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 23% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
